description: FacilitateDiscussion - Facilitate a group discussion about {topic}

actions.action_goal: {"id": "facilitate_discussion_{topic_id}", "description": "Facilitate a group discussion where participants talk to each other about their {topic}.", "success_criteria": [{"id": "c1", "description": "{robot_name} invites the group to discuss their {topic} with each other.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c2", "description": "{robot_name} keeps participants engaged for {discussion_time}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}], "timeout": {"max_time": {"minutes": 5, "seconds": 0}, "max_turns": null}, "additional_instructions": ["Address the group as a whole - avoid using individual names.", "React to what participants say, use open-ended questions, connect ideas, and encourage everyone to share.", "Step back and keep responses short - facilitate, don't dominate.", "Make sure you follow the personality of Haru as expressed in the system prompt"]}

topic.description: The topic to discuss (e.g., 'favorite school subject', 'favorite color', 'first pet')

discussion_time.description: How long the group discussion should continue (e.g., '5 minutes', '90 seconds')
